item.title: Hapitora Gaiden Aina no Shinkon Nikki
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Bloom Handle
  • 発売日: 2010-01-22
  • スコア: 6.45/10 (12 人評価)
  • 日本語名: はぴとら 外伝 アイナの新婚日記
  • 英語名: Hapitora Gaiden Aina no Shinkon Nikki

あらすじ

Aina, the island’s top ace Sylphid, continues her daily routine of showering the protagonist with affection.

With an innocent “I’m your mom and big sister substitute, after all♪,” she clings to him, sneaking into his bed or showing up in nothing but a button-up shirt—leaving him both thrilled and flustered.

item.title: Hapitora -Happy Transportation-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Bloom Handle
  • 発売日: 2009-09-25
  • スコア: 7.140000000000001/10 (29 人評価)
  • 日本語名: はぴとら－HappyTransportation－
  • 英語名: Hapitora -Happy Transportation-

あらすじ

The protagonist Tio, who lives on a small island, runs an air transportation company. He lost his parents when he was still young, so he has been working hard with the help of other workers. One day, he decides to temporarily leave the island to learn how to fly an aircraft. But when he comes back to the island a while later, he finds there is only one worker, Aina. His company is about to go bankrupt. Raica, his childhood friend, knows it and says she will join the company, but she is actually a very clumsy girl. Will Tio be able to get through this crisis?

  • 日本語名: 夏色さじたりうす
  • 英語名: Natsuiro Sagittarius

あらすじ

Just before summer holiday… Oujiro is told to join the Japanese archery club by Aika and Airi, his old friends. As a matter of fact, they are the only club members. There is no choice for him.

There are now three members in total though five members are necessary to carry on the club. Will they be able to get two more members to join?

item.title: Nami no Mani Mani ~Sazanami Shinryoujo~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Bloom Handle
  • 発売日: 2006-01-27
  • スコア: 7.3/10 (39 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 波の間に間に～さざなみ診療所～
  • 英語名: Nami no Mani Mani Sazanami Shinryoujo

あらすじ

In an isolated island at the south, the people there are excited because a new doctor is coming to the only clinic of the island.

Shinohara Shuutarou - the protagonist - is the new doctor, but he is lazy, clumsy and perverted. He starts to live at the house of the old doctor of the clinic with him, his daughter the beautiful widow Yumiko and her daughter Mana.
